types.BetterNecromancy.Mana:
Mana
Use: Right-click to fully restore mana and gain +1 max mana.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist; common boss loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.ManaCrystal:
Mana Crystal
Use: Right-click to gain +2 max mana, refill mana and speed up mana regen.
Source: Late boss loot; guaranteed from ZombieQueen and Juggernaut.
types.BetterNecromancy.ArcaneFocus:
Arcane Focus
Use: Right-click to equip permanently; the item is consumed.
Effect: +8% spell damage and -40ms wand cooldown.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist after Steel; can drop from ZombieQueen or Phase.
types.BetterNecromancy.ArcaneFocus1:
Arcane Focus I
Use: Right-click to equip permanently; the item is consumed.
Effect: +16% spell damage, -80ms cooldown and cheaper heavy casts.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist after Nitro; can drop from Fallen Ranger or Hoarder.
types.BetterNecromancy.ArcaneFocus2:
Arcane Focus II
Use: Right-click to equip permanently; the item is consumed.
Effect: +25% spell damage, -120ms cooldown and cheaper casts.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist after Nitro; can drop from Juggernaut.
types.BetterNecromancy.Esper:
Esper
Use: Rare focus reagent for advanced magic.
Source: Rare bonus when crafting Mana; also drops from undead bosses.
types.BetterNecromancy.Aether:
Aether
Use: Core healing reagent for support magic and the Aether Wand.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist from Mana and glass; also boss loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.Elementium:
Elementium
Use: High-tier arcane metal for wands, focus and Adamantine.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist from Aether and ores; also boss loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.Void:
Void
Use: Endgame reagent for Void magic and focus upgrades.
Source: Rare bonus when crafting Elementium; also drops from late bosses.
types.BetterNecromancy.InnocentSoul:
Innocent Soul
Use: Rare ritual reagent required for the Ritual Wand.
Source: Rare boss loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.MageGuardCharge:
Arcane Charge
Use: Internal mage guard focus charge.
Source: Automatically sustained by the colony.
types.BetterNecromancy.AirStone:
Air Stone
Use: Elemental upgrade used for Frost and Aether magic.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist from Elementium and copper arrows; also boss loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.EarthStone:
Earth Stone
Use: Elemental upgrade used for Void magic and heavy magical gear.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist from Elementium and stone bricks; also boss loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.FireStone:
Fire Stone
Use: Elemental upgrade used for Ember and Void magic.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist from Elementium and torches; also boss loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.WaterStone:
Water Stone
Use: Elemental upgrade used for Frost and Aether magic.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist from Elementium and water; also boss loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.ManaWand:
Mana Wand
Use: Fast starter wand. Left-click fires a bolt; right-click Overcharge chains to nearby enemies.
Source: Direct player crafting from planks; Jack-b-Nimble can drop it.
types.BetterNecromancy.BriarWand:
Briar Wand
Use: Nature wand built through the chopping block path. Left-click applies thorn bleed; right-click Brambleburst spreads pressure through a close pack.
Source: Crafted by the Woodcutter / chopping block from a Mana Wand, Mana, Herbs, firewood and planks.
types.BetterNecromancy.SparkWand:
Spark Wand
Use: Early shock wand. Left-click forks into one extra target; right-click Static Surge chains deeper through packs.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist after Glassblower from a Mana Wand, Mana, Aether, copper parts and glass.
types.BetterNecromancy.VenomWand:
Venom Wand
Use: Plague wand. Left-click stacks poison damage over time; right-click Toxic Bloom infects grouped enemies.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist after Poison from a Spark Wand, Mana, Aether, Herbs and water.
types.BetterNecromancy.EmberWand:
Ember Wand
Use: Fire wand. Left-click burns; right-click Inferno detonates in an area.
Source: Alchemist after Poison; Bulging can drop it.
types.BetterNecromancy.FrostWand:
Frost Wand
Use: Control wand. Left-click knocks back; right-click Shatter unleashes a frost nova.
Source: Alchemist after Poison; ZombieQueen and Phase can drop it.
types.BetterNecromancy.CrystalWand:
Crystal Wand
Use: Stonemason prism wand. Left-click fires a clean long-range bolt; right-click Prism Break splinters into nearby targets.
Source: Crafted by the Stonemason from a Frost Wand, Mana, Elementium, Water Stones, glass and stone bricks.
types.BetterNecromancy.StoneWand:
Stone Wand
Use: Heavy earth wand. Left-click slams targets hard; right-click Quake cracks packs with a heavy impact wave.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist after Steel from a Frost Wand, Elementium, Earth Stones, Mana and stone bricks.
types.BetterNecromancy.StormWand:
Storm Wand
Use: Aggressive chain-clear wand. Left-click forks through a few enemies; right-click Tempest floods a pack with arcs.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist after Steel from an Ember Wand, Elementium, Aether, Air Stones and Fire Stone.
types.BetterNecromancy.MagicWand:
Aether Wand
Use: Support wand. Left-click damages enemies or heals colonists; right-click heals the aimed colonist, or heals you and nearby NPCs if no ally is targeted.
Source: Alchemist after Steel; Fallen Ranger can drop it.
types.BetterNecromancy.BloodWand:
Blood Wand
Use: Late siphon wand. Left-click steals life on hit; right-click Hemorrhage drains and bleeds the target cluster.
Source: Crafted by the Alchemist after Nitro from an Aether Wand, Void, Adamantine, Elementium, Mana Crystal and Mana.
types.BetterNecromancy.VoidWand:
Void Wand
Use: Endgame burst wand. Left-click hits hard; right-click Rupture tears through grouped enemies.
Source: Alchemist after Nitro; Juggernaut can drop it.
types.BetterNecromancy.AstralManaWand:
Astral Mana Wand
Use: Evolved Mana Wand. Keeps the original spells and starts its own 10-level Evolution Mastery.

types.BetterNecromancy.MageGuardT1:
Apprentice Mage Guard
Use: Long-range night guard post that fires free raw mana bolts.
Ammo: None.
Source: Crafted by the Job Block Crafter.
types.BetterNecromancy.MageGuardT2:
Adept Mage Guard
Use: Long-range night guard post that fires free sharpened arcane bolts.
Ammo: None.
Source: Crafted by the Job Block Crafter after Poison.
types.BetterNecromancy.MageGuardT3:
Sanctified Mage Guard
Use: Long-range high-tier night guard post that channels free sanctified spellfire.
Ammo: None.
Source: Crafted by the Job Block Crafter after Steel.
types.BetterNecromancy.MageGuardT4:
Archmage Guard
Use: Rare boss-drop guard post with super-long-range storm magic.
Ammo: None.
Source: Dropped by late bosses.
types.BetterNecromancy.MageGuardT5:
Voidbound Mage Guard
Use: Rare endgame boss-drop guard post with super-long-range void blasts.
Ammo: None.
Source: Dropped by Juggernaut and Hoarder.
types.BetterNecromancy.MageGuardT6:
Ritual Ascendant
Use: Ritual reward guard post forged from mass sacrifice with extreme range.
Ammo: None.
Source: Awarded each time the Ritual Wand reaches another 1000 sacrificed colonists.
types.BetterNecromancy.BootsOfFalling:
Boots of Falling
Use: Right-click to equip permanently; the item is consumed.
Effect: Reduces or negates falling damage.
Source: Alchemist craft; Jack-b-Nimble can drop it.
types.BetterNecromancy.Bandage:
Bandage
Use: Right-click to heal yourself over time, or left-click a colonist to treat them.
Source: Tailor crafting and Putrid Corpse loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.TreatedBandage:
Treated Bandage
Use: Stronger right-click self-heal over time, or left-click a colonist to treat them.
Source: Alchemist support craft and Putrid Corpse loot.
types.BetterNecromancy.Anitbiotic:
Antibiotic
Use: Medical alchemy ingredient for Treated Bandages.
Source: Crafted with Herbs; also drops from Putrid Corpse.
types.BetterNecromancy.Adamantine:
Adamantine
Use: Endgame magical metal for Void-tier gear and upgrades.
Source: Smelted from nuggets or dropped by late bosses.
types.BetterNecromancy.HealthBooster:
Health Booster
Use: Right-click to equip permanently; the item is consumed.
Effect: Passive health regeneration.
Source: Rare Juggernaut reward and late Alchemist craft.
types.BetterNecromancy.ManaFlightHarness:
Mana Flight Harness
Use: Right-click to unlock Mana Flight permanently; the item is consumed.
Effect: Press F to enter mana-powered flight. Early mastery tiers are unstable and costly.
Source: Late Alchemist craft.
